game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the fire warden must hold off lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Parenthesis Puzzle: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the smelter.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: In Basalt Stair, repeat each round: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the smelter. Then check puzzle_gap and advance.
player_objective: Protect the smelter from lava imps in Basalt Stair: keep puzzle_gap above zero until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Parenthesis Puzzle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 9, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
